items.title: Nasa launches mission to save falling space telescope
items.summary: A Nasa-funded robot has blasted off to catch a falling telescope in mid-orbit and blast it back to safety before it burns up.

items.title: Five killed in Ukraine a day after deadliest Russian attacks this year
items.summary: Separately, at least 10 people killed in Ukrainian attacks on Russia and Russian-controlled areas.

items.title: UN sounds ‘red alert’ over human rights catastrophe in Sudan’s el-Obeid
items.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Turk issued the warning over growing fears of an imminent RSF assault.

items.title: Moldova: Prime Minister Munteanu resigns
items.summary: Alexandru Munteanu announced his surprise resignation after just eight months as head of the government. President Maia Sandu said a successor would be appointed "quickly" in order to continue Moldova's pro-EU course.
